2_star.sourceTitle: Best 2-Star Hotels in Mexico City (Prices & Reviews) | Trip.com
2_star.evidenceText: Trip.com identifies Mexico City 2-star hotels and reports an average weekday price of US$93 and weekend price of US$103.
2_star.referencePeriod: Trip.com page crawled 4 days before retrieval
2_star.searchQuery: site:trip.com/hotels/star2/city Mexico City Mexico Trip.com 2-star weekday average price
2_star.reason: Exact city and 2-star class are identified with a numeric weekday average. Weekend value is retained as evidence only; occupancy and tax treatment remain unknown.

3_star.sourceTitle: Best 3-star Hotels in Mexico City - Latest Prices & Reviews | Trip.com
3_star.evidenceText: The exact-city Trip.com page reports the average Mexico City 3-star hotel price as CAD 203 on weekdays and CAD 215 on weekends.
3_star.referencePeriod: Trip.com page crawled 3 weeks before retrieval
3_star.searchQuery: site:trip.com/hotels/star3/city Mexico City Mexico Trip.com 3-star weekday average price
3_star.reason: Exact city and 3-star class are identified with a numeric weekday average in the page's displayed CAD viewer currency. No currency conversion, occupancy inference, or tax inference was made.
